extracted.intended_audience: English learners, teachers, travelers, and anyone wanting to learn British vs American vocabulary
extracted.subtask_description: A bilingual (British vs American) vocabulary reference listing 500 word pairs presented with images to help learners identify equivalent terms across UK and US English. Designed as a study/resource page for students, teachers, and travelers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / length
rubrics_metrics.description: 500 British vs American English words with pictures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article presents a clear and simple list of 500 word pairs covering many categories (Common Words, Daily Used UK and US English Words, Vocabulary for Kids and Adults, etc.). Sections include headings such as 'Common Words', 'Daily Used', 'Easy Word Pairs', 'Differences', 'Short Examples', and alphabetized groupings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format / presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Each word is shown with an image and both versions of the word to help you learn easily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The resource pairs the British term with the American equivalent (e.g., 'lift' — 'elevator') and (per the intro) uses images to aid learning. The page emphasizes clarity and simplicity to reduce confusion for learners and travelers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target audience / suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Perfect for students, teachers, travelers, and anyone who wants to speak and understand English confidently, no matter which side of the world they’re on.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The content is presented for both kids and adults (several section headings explicitly reference 'Kids and Adults'); suitable for ESL learners, classroom use, self-study, or travel reference.
